data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Bilquis refers to the Queen of Sheba who converted to Islam after meeting the Prophet Solomon. She is known for her kindness, generosity, and wisdom. The name Bilquis carries the meaning “Queen of Sheba” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bilquis usually hope their child will grow to embody queen of sheba and live with faith, good character and purpose.
